articles.company_name: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation Common Stock New
articles.summary: Net revenues of $1.17 billion, down 11.0% on a reported basis and up 1.4% on a same-park basis(3) Net loss attributable to Six Flags of $366.1 million, or $3.59 per diluted share, which included $687.7 million of non-cash impairment charges, compared with a loss of $1.19 billion in the prior-year quarter, which included a $1.52 billion non-cash impairment charge Adjusted EBITDA(1) of $493.2 million, down 11.1% on a reported basis and up 1.1% on a same-park basis(3) Net cash from operating activities year-to-date up 36.5% to $498.5 million Liquidity of $1.06 billion at quarter-end Six Flags Entertainment Corporation (NYSE: FUN) (the “Company” or “Six Flags”), the largest regional amusement park operator in North America, today announced results for its 2026 third quarter ended September 27, 2026. Prior-year results include eight parks that Six Flags no longer operates in 2026: seven parks sold to EPR Properties prior to the start of 2026 park operations and one park in Bowie, Maryland
articles.title: Six Flags Entertainment Corporation Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results
